unit.why: A short anecdote about two tzaddikim travelling: one of them learns fear of Heaven from a villager who holds back his anger at his old father.

stories.start_quote: שמעתי איך שהיו נוסעים שני צדיקים בדרך
stories.end_quote: מ״מ מנע א״ע מחמת יראת שמים
stories.summary_en: Two tzaddikim stop at a village while travelling; one goes into a house to smoke his pipe and says he learned fear of Heaven there, having seen a villager who, enraged at his old father for holding a calf's head badly, refrained from striking him only out of fear of God.

quotes: היו נוסעים שני צדיקים בדרך ובאו לכפר אחד
tags.why: the tzaddikim travel and the lesson comes during a stop on the way

quotes: הלך אחד מהם לבית לעשן הלולקע
tags.why: the tzaddik goes into the house to smoke his pipe, which sets up the scene

quotes: שלמדתי יראת שמים בתוך זה הזמן
מ״מ מנע א״ע מחמת יראת שמים
tags.why: fear of Heaven is the lesson of the story

quotes: ונתכעס מאוד על אביו ואמר לו בכעס גדול
tags.why: the villager's rage at his father

quotes: אלמלא שאני ירא מד׳ בקעתי את מוחך בקרדום
tags.why: he holds back a violent urge out of fear of God
the tale shows the virtue of fear of Heaven, learned even from a simple villager

quotes: שאל לו חבירו למה שהה כל כך
tags.why: an exchange between two tzaddikim who are companions, not master and disciple
father–son relationship, though it is the villager's family, not the tzaddik's; borderline

missing_concepts: learning a religious lesson from a simple or uneducated person
